files.description: 64-page PDF data dictionary documenting all 23 JSON export files in the myUnity EHI export. Contains field-level definitions (name, type, description) for 404 fields across demographics, clinical, billing, assessments, and administrative data domains. Last updated 08/15/2024.

HTML page for the myUnity EHI All Data Export documentation hub. Contains description of export format (JSON files in ZIP), link to the PDF data dictionary, and variability disclaimers about organization-specific configurations.
Screenshot of the EHI All Data Export page for myUnity showing the page header, description text, and 'CLICK HERE' PDF download link.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts the PDF data dictionary into structured JSON. Uses pdftotext for text extraction, then regex parsing to identify file sections and field definitions.
Structured JSON extraction of the full EHI export data dictionary: 23 export files, 404 fields with name/type/description, file descriptions, CCD section listings, and summary statistics.
Extraction accounting: lists all discovered/parsed files and notes about parsing limitations.
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, inputs, outputs, and known limitations.
